prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: faithful original 2D game UI color texture HD repaint.
Input image1 is the exact original artwork entire canvas, enlarged nearest and whole affine3:1 to1536x512, never cropped or padded. Edit only this artwork with fine smooth source-scale painted transitions. Output the same entire 3:1 canvas; it will be inverse whole resized to original logical4x. Preserve each shape, edge, UV location, full-canvas margin, relative shading, material, pattern count/pitch/phase and detail scale. Match the source broad color hierarchy closely; overall brightness is adjusted numerically afterwards, so do not whiten rims or brighten edges relative to the center. Flat regions must remain flat. Retain the source soft low-contrast appearance; do not interpret faint pixels as new details. No crop, padding, bounding-box fitting, reframing, recentering, rotation, extra border, letterboxing, new objects, text, symbols, bolts, bevels, ornaments, pores, coarse grain, stone/fabric texture, repeated curls or hatching. No scene generation, mockup, perspective or lighting redesign.
Exact source artwork: Exactly one plain soft blue-gray painted rounded rectangular input-panel background. Preserve the same soft dark perimeter, corner roundness and smooth subtle left-to-right blue-gray wash. Entire source soft partially transparent painted panel: keep its full footprint and partial transparency. No extra inner outline, border or bright rim, no surface grain. Original logical299x34 shown via source-only whole affine3:1 guide, inverse whole output1196x136.
reference_recipe: Exact original RGBA entire canvas nearest source-only whole affine3:1 guide1536x512; no crop/padding/bbox/artistic edits. Raw entire-canvas normalized to logical4x Lanczos only, source alpha/numeric brightness handled by root.

review_requirements: Inspect decoded original before imagegen; resolve UV and atlas layout.
Preserve original logical size, alpha, material, repeat/detail scale and character identity.
Do not infer acceptance from historical/release equality; inspect normalized generation privately.
source_record.source_match: Exact decoded RGBA and dimensions match release
